name: Rokugatsu no Marriage Blue
source:
―――It's raining.
When I woke up, there was a stranger next to me.
He says we're engaged.
Forget engagement, I don't even have a lover.
...Just who is this man?

[translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5235]NovelGame[/url]]
